# BuyIASLeads

> Exclusive fixed indexed annuity (FIA) leads for licensed insurance agents. Every lead is generated for one agent only — introduced under your name the moment the prospect opts in, nurtured for a full year, and delivered to your CRM. Never shared, never resold.

BuyIASLeads is operated by Pacific Ridgeway Insurance Solutions and was built by Gregory Stevenson, author of *Index Annuity Secrets* and a producing fixed indexed annuity agent who sells the same products these leads are generated for (not a marketer).

## Key facts
- Product: Exclusive fixed indexed annuity (FIA) leads for licensed agents.
- Exclusivity: Each lead goes to one agent only — never shared, resold, or recycled.
- Nurture: Prospects are introduced under the agent's name, then kept warm with Annuity University (education), Oscar (a 24/7 AI assistant), a free book, and a 52-week email & text campaign.
- Delivery: Leads flow into the agent's CRM as prospects opt in.
- Founder: Gregory Stevenson — author of *Index Annuity Secrets*, producing FIA agent.
- Trusted by: licensed insurance agents across the United States.
- Serves: United States; leads generated in the states the agent is licensed in.
- Contact: stevenson@pacificridgewayinsurance.com · (619) 374-8100

## Pricing
- 100 exclusive FIA leads — $2,000 (one-time)
- 200 exclusive FIA leads — $3,000 (one-time, most popular)
- 400 exclusive FIA leads — $5,000 (one-time, best per-lead value)
- Each package includes a CRM seat at $100/month, cancellable anytime. No long-term contract.

## Why agents choose BuyIASLeads
- Exclusive, not shared — no racing other agents to the same prospect.
- Warm, not cold — prospects expect the agent's call.
- Run by a producing agent who closes these exact leads.
- A single annuity case typically pays for a whole package several times over.
